response.rationale: Option A and D are both 'equivalent' to the top-ranked leaf 'Paroxysmal atrioventricular block (phase IV block) in His-Purkinje system'. Since both have the same support and confidence scores, their relative order is arbitrary. Options C and B are unmatched and therefore ranked lower. Option C is placed before B as it is a type of AV block, which is closer to the topic than a general third-degree AV block.
